claims.quote: CDKL5 is a brain-enriched serine/threonine kinase
associated with a profound developmental and epileptic encephalopathy called CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD).

claims.object_text: conditional Cdkl5 knockout mice in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons and astrocytes
claims.quote: We generated conditional Cdkl5 knockout mice in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons and astrocytes.
phosphorylated EB2, a well-known substrate of CDKL5.

claims.object_text: EB2 pS222 presence in excitatory and inhibitory neurons but not astrocytes
claims.quote: CDKL5 and EB2 pS222 were prominent in excitatory and inhibitory neurons but were not detected in astrocytes.

claims.object_text: residual EB2 pS222 in Cdkl5 knockout brains and primary neurons (~15-20%)
claims.quote: approximately 15-20% of EB2 pS222 remained in Cdkl5 knockout brains and primary neurons.

claims.object_text: presence of a compensating kinase modulated by NMDA and PP1/PP2A
claims.quote: the remaining phosphorylation was modulated by NMDA and PP1/PP2A in neuronal CDKL5 knockout cultures, indicating the presence of a compensating kinase.

claims.object_text: CDKL2 and ICK phosphorylate EB2 S222
claims.quote: CDKL2 and ICK can phosphorylate EB2 S222 in HEK293T cells and in primary neurons.

claims.object_text: CDKL2 phosphorylates CDKL5 substrates in the brain
